title: Hyvinvointialueen terveydenhuollon laskutuksessa voi olla tänä syksynä viivettä
content:
Pohjois-Savon hyvinvointialueen yhteisen potilastietojärjestelmän käyttöönotto erikoissairaanhoidossa on 14. lokakuuta. Lokakuun aloitus koskee niin KYSiä, Iisalmen ja Varkauden erikoissairaanhoitoa kuin Kuopion erikoissairaanhoidon yksiköitä.

Samassa aikataulussa lokakuussa vaihtuu myös terveydenhuollon asiakaslaskutukseen käytettävä ohjelma. Sen takia asiakkaat voivat saada laskunsa tavallista myöhemmin. Viive koskee niin terveyskeskusten kuin KYSin laskutusta.

- Pyydämme asiakkailta ymmärrystä muutoksen aikana. Laskutuksessa voi esiintyä viivettä eikä laskutuksessa välttämättä voida huomioida maksukaton ylittymistä automaattisesti. Mahdolliset laskutusviiveet käsitellään kuitenkin jälkikäteen, laskutuspäällikkö Tiina Roininen sanoo.

Terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksuilla on vuosittainen maksukatto, jonka täytyttyä suurin osa julkisen terveydenhuollon maksuista muuttuu maksuttomiksi loppuvuodeksi. Maksukatto vuonna 2026 on 815 euroa ja asiakkaan täytyy lain mukaan itse seurata maksukattonsa ylittymistä. Lisätietoa maksukatosta löytyy hyvinvointialueen verkkosivuilta.

title: Vinnarna i Wiki Loves Earth 2026
content:
Nu är det äntligen dags att presentera vinnarna av Wiki Loves Earth 2026 i Sverige! Under maj månad har fotografer från hela landet gett sig ut för att dokumentera Sveriges skyddade natur och dela sina bilder med resten av världen. Juryn har under sommaren gått igenom årets bidrag och nu har de bästa bilderna utsetts.

I årets tävling deltog 60 fotografer som tillsammans laddade upp hela 1 266 bilder från naturreservat, nationalparker, naturminnen och biosfärområden runt om i Sverige. Bidragen visar på den stora variationen i Sveriges natur – från vidsträckta landskap till flora och fauna.

Alla bilder som laddas upp i Wiki Loves Earth publiceras på Wikimedia Commons under fri licens. Det innebär att de kan användas av alla och dessutom bidra till att illustrera Wikipediaartiklar och sprida kunskap om Sveriges naturarv.

Det är med stor glädje som vi nu kan presentera årets vinnare!

Bilparadiset15 tar hem förstaplatsen i Wiki Loves Earth 2026 med denna bild från Pellokielas urskog i Norrbottens län.

title: Wikimania 2026: lessons learnt and challenges for the future of free knowledge
content:
From 21 to 25 July, Paris hosted the 21st edition of Wikimania, the annual gathering that brings together the global Wikimedia community to share experiences, discuss the movement’s challenges and continue to shape the future of free knowledge. 

Under the slogan “Liberté, Équité, Fiabilité” (Freedom, Equity and Reliability), Wikimania 2026 addressed some of the major challenges facing Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects: artificial intelligence, disinformation, governance, open education, the preservation of knowledge and the strengthening of communities. 

From Wikimedia Spain, Rubén Ojeda, Project Manager, and Jorge Jaramillo, a member of the organisation, took part in this event and share with us some of the lessons learnt and experiences they have brought back from Paris.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI’s long-overdue gameplay reveal – as it happened
content:
Under some strange circumstances, Rockstar broadcast the first (official) gameplay footage of Grand Theft Auto VI, the most-anticipated game of the year. Here’s everything you need to know.

Ah yes, it’s a drug den. We’re in familiar GTA territory here: narcotics, smart phones, tattooed gangsters and a police raid. The duo shoot their way out of the room – the gunplay is very familiar to the series – third-person over the shoulder. I’m getting a distinct True Romance/Leon vibe to this chaos.

These closeup slow-motion kill shots are giving me flashbacks to Fallout 3 and its slightly sickening VATS violence.

title: Labor Supply Shock and Firm Innovation: Evidence from EU Enlargement
content: This study examines the effects of the 2004 European Union enlargement on firm productivity and innovation in Finland. Using linked employer–employee and firm-level data, the analysis exploits increased access to workers from the ten new EU member states (EU10). To address the endogenous geographic distribution of immigrants, I construct an instrumental variable based on historically predetermined migration patterns. The results show that increased EU10 employment raises firm labor productivity, the probability of having a granted patent, and STEM employment, while effects on other innovation outcomes are more limited. The responses also differ across sectors. In manufacturing, EU10 employment increases process innovation but reduces STEM employment, whereas in services it increases labor productivity and the probability of having granted patents. Overall, the findings suggest that immigration-induced labor-supply changes can improve firm performance and affect selected dimensions of innovation, with the effects varying across sectors and innovation margins.

title: Arktinen geopolitiikka puhuttaa Rovaniemen pääkirjastolla
content:
Arktinen alue on tällä hetkellä geopolitiikan ytimessä. Lapin yliopiston Arktisen keskuksen ja Ulkopoliittisen instituutin järjestämässä tilaisuudessa aihetta tarkastellaan niin paikallisesta kuin globaalista näkökulmasta.

Millä tavoin Yhdysvaltain presidentti Donald Trumpin puheet Grönlannin liittämisestä muuttavat arktista geopolitiikkaa? Onko arktinen yhteistyö enää mahdollista Venäjän hyökkäyssodan ollessa käynnissä? Miten ilmastonmuutos vaikuttaa arktiseen turvallisuuteen ja alueen ihmisiin?

Näistä ja monista muista kysymyksistä keskustellaan Rovaniemen pääkirjastossa torstaina 3.9. klo 17.30–19.00, kun Lapin yliopiston Arktinen keskus ja Ulkopoliittinen instituutti järjestävät yleisötilaisuuden, jonka aiheena ovat geopoliittiset kysymykset arktisella alueella.

Keskustelemassa ovat arktisen turvallisuuden ja geopolitiikan tutkimusprofessori Sanna Kopra, Ulkopoliittisen instituutin vt. apulaisjohtaja Harri Mikkola sekä Suomen ympäristökeskuksen erikoistutkija Marja Helena Sivonen, joka toimii myös Suomen arktisen seuran puheenjohtajana ja Saamelaisen ilmastoneuvoston jäsenenä.

title: Renewing intellectual history in the age of AI
content:
In 2026, Helsinki Computational History Group is entering a new phase. Over the previous decade, COMHIS helped establish bibliographic data science, integrated workflows for historical newspapers, large-scale text-reuse research and computational studies of publishing and public discourse. That accumulated interdisciplinary work now supports a closer connection between intellectual-historical questions, AI development and production computing.

The change is practical as well as conceptual. New language and vision models can be tested against historical collections on CSC’s computing infrastructure, and results can arrive quickly enough to alter the live research design. A failed image crop, a misleading semantic match or a book-specific layout convention is no longer merely cleaned away at the end: it can become the reason to revise the data, model, validation rule or historical question.

title: Lappeenrannan uusin Meijän tähet -laatta myönnettiin kirjailija Heikki Hietamiehelle – Iida Karhunen palkittiin Elämän nälkä -palkinnolla
content:
Lappeenrannan uusi Meijän tähet -laatan saaja on julkistettu 27.8.2026 pidetyssä yleisötilaisuudessa Marianaukiolla. Kunnialaatan sai tällä kertaa kirjailija Heikki Hietamies. Uudesta Meijän tähestä voi lukea tarkemmin lisää kaupungin verkkosivustolta.

Meijän tähet -kunnialaatoilla muistetaan merkkihenkilöitä, joilla on selkeä kytkös Lappeenrantaan sekä osaamista ja näkyvyyttä kulttuurin, urheilun tai tieteen saralla. Hän voi olla edesmennyt tai edelleen keskuudessamme. Päätöksen laatan saajista tekee Lappeenrannan kaupunginhallitus.

Yleisötilaisuudessa julkistettiin samalla myös tämän vuoden Elämän nälkä -palkinnon saaja. Tuhannen euron arvoisen stipendin sekä muistoesineen sai tänä vuonna taitoluistelija Iida Karhunen.

Elämän nälkä -palkinto jaetaan vuosittain yhdelle 13–29-vuotiaalle nuorelle esimerkiksi ansioista taloudellisen, sosiaalisen, ekologisen ja kulttuurisen kestävän kehityksen edistäjänä, urheilu- tai kulttuurimenestyksestä tai rohkeudesta katsoa tulevaisuuteen ja olla kumppani nykypäivän globaalissa yhteiskunnassa. Päätöksen tekee kaupunginhallitus.

title: Tornion Kotiseutupäivät viikonloppuna ovat jymymenestys
content:
Valtakunnalliset kotiseutupäivät kokoavat viikonlopuksi Tornioon kotiseutuväkeä eri puolilta Suomea. Yli 70 tapahtuman viikonloppu on samalla Lapin ja Tornionlaakson oma kotiseutujuhla, johon paikalliset yhdistykset ja kulttuuritoimijat ovat lähteneet innolla mukaan. Torniossa on Kotiseutupäivien alla vilinää. Osa tapahtumista myytiin loppuun jo pari viikkoa ennen ilmoittautumisen päättymistä. Tapahtuma on kaikille avoin.

Tänä viikonloppuna kotiseutuharrastajat ja kulttuuriperintöammattilaiset suuntaavat pohjoiseen Tornion Kotiseutupäiville sankoin joukoin. Tapahtuma on ainutlaatuinen tilaisuus tutustua Tornionlaakson omaleimaiseen kulttuuriin, historiaan ja rajaseudun elämään. Mehukkaasta ohjelmasta huolimatta tapahtuman suosio yllätti järjestäjät iloisesti.

”Menestys on lyönyt meidät ällikällä. Upeaa että väki tulee tänne pohjoiseen!”, tapahtumatuottajat Jenni Nuorala ja Elina Hollanti sanovat.

Ohjelmassa näkyvät niin meänkieli, lippokalastus, paikallinen rakennusperintö, Lapin sodan historia kuin Tornion ja Haaparannan yhteinen rajaseutu.

title: September är också journalisternas månad
content:
Jobbar du som journalist, konstkritiker eller recensent? Eller studerar du journalistik? I september tar vi emot ansökningar om journaliststipendier. Myös suomenkieliset toimittajat voivat hakea apurahaa.

Tiesitkö, että suomenkieliset journalistit, jotka kirjoittavat ruotsinkielisistä teemoista suomenkielisiin medioihin voivat hakea apurahaa? Lue lisää aiheesta (ruotsiksi).

Vi beviljar alla journaliststipendier i samarbete med Amos Andersons fond.

  • journalister som är yrkesverksamma på svenska i Finland och ska jobba 1-3 månader på en tidningsredaktion i ett annat nordiskt land
  • journalister som är yrkesverksamma i Norden och ska jobba 1-3 månader på en svenskspråkig tidningsredaktion i Finland
  • journalister som för finskspråkiga medier ska skriva om det svenska i Finland
  • recensenter som i andra nordiska länder ska skriva om konst och kultur på svenska i Finland
  • fortbildning, nätverkande och konstkritik för yrkesverksamma journalister
  • att öka unga journalisters kunskap om Norden

    • Via länkarna ovan kan du läsa mera om de olika typerna av journaliststipendier.

    Ansökan är öppen mellan den 1 och 30 september 2026.

title: Ny bok: Varför skrek Josele? Berättelser om judiskt liv i Finland
content:
Hur såg livet ut i den finländsk-judiska gemenskapen för hundra år sedan? Genom Jac Weinsteins ögon öppnas dörren till en levande kultur präglad av traditioner, flerspråkighet och stark sammanhållning, men också av svåra minnen från Förintelsen.

 Affärsmannen Jac Weinstein var en central gestalt i den judiska församlingen i Helsingfors under 1900-talets första hälft. Genom minnen, krönikor, noveller och texter ursprungligen skrivna på jiddisch berättar han i antologin Varför skrek Josele? om allt från familjeliv och högtider till judisk teater och sport, men också om erfarenheterna under andra världskriget.

– I finländsk-judisk kontext var Weinstein unik. Ingen annan i hans generation har veterligen skrivit både minnen och skönlitteratur – och dessutom publicerat texterna, säger utgivarna Simo Muir och Eva Odrischinsky.

title: När AI möter piprensare och människor varandra
content:
Som en del av Riksantikvarieämbetets arbete med publikutveckling arrangerade vi i maj 2026 en praktisk workshop med temat ”AI för publika miljöer”. Två dagars praktiskt workshoppande i Visby följdes upp med ett öppet seminarium med möjlighet att delta på plats eller digitalt.

Evenemanget riktade sig till alla som arbetar med eller är intresserade av det publika mötet och praktik inom museer, utställningar och kulturarvsinstitutioner.

Workshopen genomfördes som en vidareutveckling av de nätverksträffar inom nätverket Immersiva medier som Riksantikvarieämbetet genomfört under åren 2020–2025. Nätverket för immersiva medier startades som ett informellt nätverk för alla som är intresserade av utvecklingen inom detta område, med en Facebookgrupp med samma namn och de återkommande nätverksträffarna som fasta samlingspunkter. Vid tiden för bildandet av nätverket fanns ett stort intresse för och behov av diskussion kring frågor rörande immersiva medier; ett område som då ofta upplevdes som ”nytt” och främmande för framför allt museer.

content:
When it was published in the United States in 1998, Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone was retitled Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone. The jokes about the American reading public’s apparent allergy to the very word philosopher write themselves, but the change was also unfortunate for more substantial reasons. A “sorcerer’s stone” had no cultural resonance at all, whereas the philosopher’s stone had been sought after since, at the very latest, the dawn of the fourth century. Some sources claim that human knowledge of it goes all the way back to Adam, who got the word directly from God. In any case, it’s no mystery why the philosopher’s stone has long captured the collective imagination of humanity, given that it’s reputed to turn lead into gold.

Among the rumored possessors of the philosopher’s stone throughout history is Salomon Trismosin, a sixteenth-century Renaissance alchemist who taught the influential physician Paracelsus. He’s also credited, at least in legends, with writing Splendor Solis, a book once no less desirable than the next Harry Potter volume in that series’ heyday.

title: A Computer History Time Capsule
content:
Once upon a time, before the Internet, computer hobbyists went to great lengths to learn about their new technology. Many of these learning opportunities were inherently social: computer classes, software store hangouts, electronic bulletin board systems, and user groups.

A user group or computer club was a wonderful way to get to know people in your region who were also learning about computers. They’d meet once a week or once a month at a computer store or pizza parlor or someone’s basement. Some groups met to play and trade games, some to write software, some to explore what the world of personal computing meant for their businesses.

One of the earliest groups was the Homebrew Computer Club in Silicon Valley, California, which had its first meeting in 1975. That was just a seed: thousands of regional computer groups quickly sprouted up around the world. Many of these groups were dedicated to one particular brand of computer, back in the day when there were countless incompatible flavors of computing machinery. Computer clubs offered various benefits to their members, such as public-domain software to trade, expert speakers at meetings, and printed newsletters.

title: Lukashenka’s ‘Capitulation’ to Zelenskyy’s Ultimatum
content:
Since January, Ukraine has noticeably hardened its public tone toward Belarus. This toughened rhetoric culminated on June 19 in President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s ultimatum to the Belarusian leader Aliaksandr Lukashenka. 

The Ukrainian president gave Minsk a week to deactivate Russian signal boosters on Belarusian territory used to control drones heading toward Ukraine. Zelenskyy added: “If he does not do it, we will.”

Although Lukashenka initially responded to Zelenskyy with his own military threats and personal insults, the Belarusian leader ultimately yielded to Kyiv’s demands. According to Ukrainian intelligence reports, Minsk deactivated the drone control systems on June 22. 

On closer inspection, however, Lukashenka’s about-face had actually taken place a week before he gave in — and four days prior to Zelenskyy’s ultimatum. title: Poland asks EU to fine Meta €250 million over scam ads
content:
Polish Deputy Prime Minister Krzysztof Gawkowski asked the European Commission to fine Meta €250 million, alleging it is failing to tackle scams and fake ads on its platforms.

Gawkowski also asked for an investigation into Facebook and Instagram’s parent company in a letter to EU tech chief Henna Virkkunen dated Aug. 26 and seen by POLITICO. Gawkowski serves as Poland’s digital affairs minister.

Scam ads are covered in a 2024 investigation under the Digital Services Act (DSA), but the Commission has yet to open any investigations specific to financial scams, nor has it imposed any fines on social media companies for lapses in how they protect users more broadly.

Meta’s reported removals of scams and fraud on its platforms in the EU “show that scams are not a marginal phenomenon occurring outside the platform’s main operating model,” but rather one of “the largest and most persistent forms of abuse within the Meta ecosystem,” the deputy PM wrote.

Polish authorities and cybersecurity teams have notified Meta multiple times, but the company still doesn’t ensure “an effective and adequate response to scam advertisements,” Gawkowski wrote.

title: Taiwan: Proposed judicial caning referendum indicates further erosion of human rights protection
content:
Ahead of the meeting of the Central Election Commission on 28 August regarding a proposed referendum on introducing judicial caning as a criminal punishment in Taiwan, Amnesty International Taiwan’s Director, E-Ling Chiu, said: 

“It is both disturbing and disgraceful that the Legislative Yuan has chosen to advance a referendum proposal on judicial caning that clearly breaches international human rights law. 

“This proposal is part of a broader pattern that has emerged in recent months. Human rights-related budgets have been cut, the work of independent institutions such as the National Human Rights Commission has been obstructed and the functioning of the Constitutional Court has been undermined. The advancement of a referendum seeking to legitimize cruel, inhuman and degrading punishment further contributes to the erosion of the human rights protection framework that Taiwan has spent decades building.” 

Amnesty International’s Deputy Regional Director Sarah Brooks added: 

“When public anger over crimes is exploited for political gain at the expense of human rights, everyone stands to lose.

This story, written by Kunda Dixit, was originally published in Nepali Times. A slightly edited version is republished on Global Voices as part of a content-sharing agreement.

Mount Langtang Lirung, the majestic mountain that towers 7,245 meters above sea level and is located 45 kilometers directly north of Kathmandu, has a tragic history.

A massive 7.8 magnitude earthquake in April 2015 shook central Nepal and triggered an avalanche on its south face, which fell into the glacier below and buried the village of Langtang, killing at least 300 people.

On August 26, 2026, there was a 4.4 magnitude earthquake near the border with China at exactly 8:37 a.m. Nepal Time (2:52 a.m. UTC). This time, it triggered a huge avalanche on the north face of Langtang.

title: Sarir Mowghen, a Baha’i Citizen, Arrested in Isfahan
content:
According to HRANA, Sarir Mowghen, a Baha’i citizen, was arrested in Isfahan.

According to information received by HRANA, at approximately 8 a.m. on Tuesday, August 25, Ministry of Intelligence agents went to the home of Sarir Mowghen’s family in Isfahan and searched the premises. Following the search, agents arrested Ms. Mowghen and transferred her to Dowlatabad Prison in Isfahan.

An informed source close to the family of the Baha’i citizen confirmed the incident to HRANA, stating: “During the search, agents confiscated all electronic devices in the home, as well as a large number of the family’s possessions, including cash, gold, and a piano.”

As of the time of this report, no information has been obtained regarding the reasons for Ms. Mowghen’s arrest or the charges brought against her.

title: Federal Presence at US Polls Could Intimidate Voters
content:
The United States Justice Department announced plans earlier this month to deploy at least 1,000 federal officers to polling places during the upcoming midterm elections. 

While such deployments are not without precedent, federal officers previously deployed during elections have been tasked with enforcing federal statutes that protect the right to vote and prohibit voter intimidation and suppression. This time, the Trump administration has cast the effort in a manner that is likely to intimidate naturalized immigrant and non-English speaking communities. Letters sent to local officials warned that they face criminal charges for allowing non-citizens to vote, coinciding with the administration’s advancement of largely debunked claims of widespread non-citizen voting in US elections. US Attorney General Todd Blanche and Director of Homeland Security Markwayne Millin have also endorsed the notion of deploying Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) or other federal agents to polling locations.

title: Rewriting Slovakia’s history: How pro-Kremlin narratives turn Ukrainians into villains and Russia into saviour
content:
Slovak Agriculture Minister Richard Takáč (Smer-SD) offered a striking reinterpretation of the 1968 Soviet invasion of Czechoslovakia during a Sunday debate on TA3. He did so while seeking to deflect criticism of a controversial report on the new Russian-Slovak intergovernmental commission.

When opposition MP Alojz Hlina (SaS) pointed out that the report had been announced just days before the anniversary of the Soviet occupation on 21 August, Takáč responded that those who invaded Czechoslovakia “were not troops of the Russian Federation”, but Ukrainian ones.

“What did the Russian Federation have to do with it? The Soviet Union consisted of several countries,” he added then, while also admitting that he was not “exactly a historian”.

No, it was not Ukrainians who came to occupy Czechoslovakia. And although the invading forces came from several Warsaw Pact countries, the decision to intervene was made by the leadership in Moscow. Moreover, the UN Charter still lists the USSR as a permanent member of the UN Security Council. After its dissolution, all sides accepted that Russia would take over its role.

title: The AI ‘Ghosts’ Contaminating Academic Publishing
content:
“Elena Vasquez and Marcus Chen have appeared as volcano experts, astronauts, thriller protagonists, podcast hosts, and academic co-authors across hundreds of independently produced AI-generated documents, never having lived,” a new preprint research paper from Samsung and the University of Warsaw said.

The paper identified a number of names that co-authored hundreds of AI-generated academic papers, articles, and books. The authors don’t actually exist, but are instead names that large language models repeatedly produce when tasked with generating experts in certain fields. 

The paper, titled “The Ghost Couple: Correlated LLM Name Priors and Their Haunting of the Web and Academic Publishing,” utilized a known phenomenon where certain LLMs will keep coming up with the same names in certain contexts. For example, In June, Sam wrote about how ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude were likely to use the name Elias Thorne in fiction they generated, and that the character was often a lighthouse keeper. Similarly, users noticed that if they ask ChatGPT to generate a software developer, their name will often be Marcus Chen.

title: Singapore Police Probe 231 Suspected Scam Mules
content:
Singapore police are investigating 231 people suspected of acting as scammers or money mules in more than 721 fraud cases that caused about S$4.1 million (US$3.2 million) in losses, authorities said Thursday.

The 149 men and 82 women, aged between 15 and 76, were identified during a two-week operation by the Cyber Command and seven police divisions. The cases involve e-commerce, phishing, job and investment scams, as well as government official impersonation and fake lucky draws.

Police are investigating the suspects for alleged cheating, money laundering or providing payment services without a license. Cheating and money laundering offenses can each carry prison terms of up to 10 years. Some scammers and people who recruit others for scam syndicates may also face mandatory caning of between six and 24 strokes.

Money mules who help move criminal proceeds or provide SIM cards or Singpass credentials can face discretionary caning of up to 12 strokes. Police said suspected mules may also have their banking services and mobile subscriptions restricted under Singapore’s Facility Restriction Framework.

title: These Local Jails Were Supposed to Detain Immigrants for Only 72 Hours. One Woman Was Held for a Total of 26 Days.
content:
Every third morning Soumia Bensalah was roused before the break of dawn. Pulled from her cell, shackled hand and foot, she was herded onto a bus and driven over Tampa Bay from the Pinellas County Jail to a cramped hold room at a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement office. 

Each time, she sat there all day, still shackled. Once evening came, she was driven back to the jail, forced to wait for hours in a hallway, photographed, strip-searched, questioned and led back to her cell. This happened five times last December, and Bensalah said it left her exhausted and humiliated.

It was no coincidence that Bensalah, a French Moroccan with a pending green card application, was released from the Pinellas jail and then sent back at regular, 72-hour intervals, according to legal experts. That’s the maximum amount of time that county jails like Pinellas’ can hold immigrants on behalf of ICE. The limit exists to prevent immigrants detained on civil charges from spending too long in jails meant for people detained on criminal charges.

title: Yksityisen kopioinnin hyvitys uudistuu Ruotsissa – kuvataideteoksista maksetaan jatkossa hyvitystä
content:
Ruotsissa yksityisen kopioinnin hyvitysjärjestelmä päivitetään vastaamaan digiajan kulutustapoja. Hyvitysmaksun piiriin kuuluvat jatkossa myös kuvataideteokset. Uusi lainsäädäntö astuu voimaan 1.9.2026.

Digitaalisuuden myötä teosten kopioinnin tavat ovat moninaistuneet. Ruotsissa hyväksyttiin kesäkuun alussa hallituksen esitys yksityisen kopioinnin hyvitysjärjestelmän uudistamisesta. Päätös merkitsee järjestelmän laajamittaista päivitystä. Uudistus tarvitaan, jotta luovan työn tekijät saavat kohtuullisen korvauksen teostensa yksityisestä kopioinnista myös digiaikana.

Muutoksen myötä hyvitys laajenee koskemaan kaikkia teoslajeja. Samalla aiemmat, teknologiaa koskevat rajoitukset lainsäädännöstä poistetaan, minkä ansiosta järjestelmä vastaa paremmin kopioinnissa nykyisin käytettävien laitteiden ja palveluiden laajaa kirjoa.

Yksityisen kopioinnin hyvitys on tekijänoikeuslain takaama rahallinen korvaus tekijöille siitä, että jokainen kansalainen saa kopioida teoksia omaan käyttöönsä laillisista lähteistä. Suomessa hyvitys päätettiin siirtää vuonna 2015 valtion budjetista maksettavaksi. Sitä ennen hyvitysmaksua kerättiin kopiointiin käytettävien laitteiden hinnassa.

title: Creating space for youth dialogue in Palestine
content:
CMI is working with young people across the West Bank and Gaza to support constructive dialogue about the future of Palestine.

A newly launched three-year initiative in the West Bank and Gaza focuses on engaging young Palestinians in structured and inclusive dialogue on the future of Palestine, with the aim of strengthening their political agency in peacemaking.

The initiative, implemented in partnership with the Palestine-based Social Developmental Forum (SDF), responds to youth’s fragmentation, shrinking civic space and generational exclusion from decision-making.

It is co-funded by the European Union, the Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Finland and Ireland and runs from 2025 to 2028. Its inception phase in 2025 was supported by Ireland and Sweden through their core funding to CMI, with additional support continuing through core funding.

In the first phase, a series of dialogue workshops aim to reach 700 young people across the West Bank and Gaza. In the following phase, participants will connect, learn, and engage in discussions through secure online and in-person formats, supported by digital consultations.

title: Kenia on yrittäjien maa – “Pysyvä työpaikka, josta voisi jäädä eläkkeelle, on illuusio”, sanoo logistiikkayritystä pyörittävä Peris Muriuki
content:
Kenian maantiet ovat pääosin kapeita, kaksikaistaisia ja rekkojen kansoittamia. Jopa 80–90 prosenttia maan rahtiliikenteestä kulkee maanteitse.

Logistiikka on kallista ja usein tehotonta. Polttoainekustannukset ovat kovia, ja jokainen tyhjällä lastilla ajettu kilometri tuo yrityksille vain kuluja ilman tuottoa.

“Logistiikka-alalla on paljon yrityksiä, jotka tarjoavat keinoja nähdä autojen sijainnin tai seurata polttoaineen kulutusta ja muita kuluja. Meidän yrityksemme tarjoaa enemmän: näytämme yrityksille, miten liiketoiminnan voi optimoida ja vähentää hiilipäästöjä. Olemme myös afrikkalainen yritys, joka on kehitetty Afrikan oloihin“, kertoo Peris Muriuki.

Hän on 25-vuotias kenialainen ohjelmistoinsinööri ja yksi kolmesta vuonna 2025 toimintansa aloittaneen Sanasana-startup-yrityksen perustajista.

Keniassa moni Muriukin kaltainen nuori haluaa työllistyä yrittäjänä eikä palkkatyöntekijänä. Yhä useampi koulutettu nuori tähtää kasvuyrittäjäksi erityisesti teknologia-alalla.

title: The Latest Chapter In American Military Muddling
content:
On day one of America’s supposedly “most precise” aerial bombing campaign in history, 150 people, including 120 children, at Iran’s Shajareh Tayyebeh Elementary School, were killed.

Over the following weeks, nearly two dozen more schools along with 10 hospitals were also hit by air strikes. And a strike on a petroleum facility near Tehran caused a persistent “oily rain” to fall on heavily populated areas, leading to a range of immediate and still-emerging health problems.

These incidents and others like them — bombs falling on homes and public spaces — undermine U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth’s claims of precision.

But whatever the level of accuracy, or lack thereof, of the joint U.S.-Israel military actions, it is clear that the mistakes made during “Epic Fury” are being laid at the door of artificial intelligence; in particular, the Maven Smart System, an AI platform that is supposed to integrate nine major sensory systems — including video, signals intelligence and radar — and draws upon historical databases as well as the “real-time” information of drones, satellites and other technologies.

title: How Ukraine is bringing the war home to Russia
content:
In recent weeks, Ukrainian drones have targeted large warehouses across Russia, destroying millions of dollars of merchandise stored inside them.

These warehouses and logistics hubs belong to Wildberries, the Russian equivalent to Amazon.  Ukraine is taking aim at Ozon, Russia’s second-largest online retailer, too.

Ukraine says it’s targeting these companies because they’ve been providing supplies to soldiers on the front line.

But according to Matthew Sussex, associate professor in strategic studies at Deakin University in Australia, who talked to The Conversation Weekly podcast, Kyiv’s strategy also intends to disrupt the lives of everyday Russians.

When you put in an online order that can’t go through because the merchandise has been blown up by Ukrainian drones, that starts to put indirect political pressure on people like Vladimir Putin because it hits the everyday Russian consumer.

content:
Vihreiden kansanedustaja Atte Harjanne ja kaupunginvaltuutettu Suvi Pulkkinen ehdottavat, että vanhustenhoidon kulujen kattamiseksi pitäisi kokeilla myös hoidettavan omaisuuden realisoimista.

Nykyisin esimerkiksi hoivakotimaksut määräytyvät hoidettavan eläkkeen ja tulojen mukaan. Kaksikon Verde-lehdessä esittelemässä ehdotuksessa hyvinvointialue voisi katsoa myös, onko hoidettavalla omistusasuntoja, kiinteistöjä, arvopapereita tai muuta käypää varallisuutta.

Hyvinvointialue antaisi ympärivuorokautistakin hoitoa ilmaiseksi, mutta ottaisi todelliset kulut myöhemmin hoidettavan omaisuuden myynnistä.

Pienituloisillakin eläkeläisillä kun voi olla velaton kesämökki tai asunto, joka olisi realisoitavissa, kirjoittajat pohtivat.

title: YK vaatii Suomelta nopeampia toimia vihapuhetta ja etnistä profilointia vastaan
content:
YK:n rotusyrjinnän poistamista käsittelevä komitea (CERD) antoi maanantaina 24. elokuuta loppupäätelmänsä Suomen ihmisoikeustilanteesta. Komitea vaatii valtiota kiirehtimään erityisesti rikoslain uudistamista ja kieltämään etnisen profiloinnin lainsäädännössä.

CERD valvoo YK:n rotusyrjinnän poistamista koskevaa yleissopimusta. Sopimusvaltioiden tulee raportoida komitealle määräajoin. Viime viikolla Genevessä käsiteltiin Suomen yhdistettyä määräaikaisraporttia, ensimmäistä kertaa vuoden 2017 jälkeen.

Suomea kyllä kiitetäänkin useista uudistuksista. Myönteistä huomiota saa muun muassa elokuussa 2025 voimaan tullut saamelaiskäräjälain uudistus, joka vahvisti saamelaisten itsemääräämisoikeutta ja oikeutta päättää saamelaiskäräjien vaaliluettelosta. Erityisen myönteisenä pidetään saamelaisten totuus- ja sovintokomission työn valmistumista. Totuuskomission loppuraportti julkaistiin viime joulukuussa, ja se käsitteli muun muassa rakenteellista syrjintää, kieli- ja maaoikeuksia sekä kulttuurin elvyttämistä.

title: Satakunta on Suomen ja koko Itämeren turvallisuusrannikko
content:
Satakunta rajautuu lännessä Itämereen ja merellisyys näkyy vahvasti alueen elinkeinoissa sekä esimerkiksi Porin ja Rauman satamissa. Satakunta on keskeinen tekijä, kun puhutaan Suomen turvallisuuden, huoltovarmuuden ja maamme länsiyhteyksien vahvistamisesta.

Itämeren rooli on jatkuvassa muutoksessa – ja tämä on korostunut viime vuosina. Nato-jäsenyytemme, Venäjän hyökkäyssota Ukrainassa ja kasvaneet hybridiuhat ovat muuttaneet Suomen ja koko merialueen turvallisuusympäristöä. Satamat, merikaapelit ja meriliikenne ovat kriittistä infrastruktuuria, joiden toimivuus turvaa yhteiskuntamme toimintakykyä.

Keskeinen – ellei jopa keskeisin – työ Suomen turvallisuuden eteen tehdään maakunnissa. Siellä, missä satamat toimivat, teollisuus luo elinvoimaa, ihmiset kouluttautuvat ja viranomaiset tekevät laajaa yhteistyötä yli aluerajojen. Satakunnalla on tässä poikkeuksellisen paljon annettavaa.

Porissa toimii Suomen monipuolisin turvallisuuden harjoittelukeskus: Turvallisuuskeskus. 38 hehtaarin alue mahdollistaa eri viranomaisten, puolustus- ja turvallisuusorganisaatioiden, pelastustoimen ja yritysten turvallisuusskenaarioiden harjoittelun todentuntuisissa ympäristöissä.

title: Countdown Begins to the Language Diversity Conference 2026
content:
The countdown to the Language Diversity Conference 2026 has officially begun, marking the start of an exciting journey toward a global gathering that will celebrate linguistic diversity, strengthen language communities, and promote inclusive participation in the open knowledge movement.

Scheduled to take place in Accra, Ghana, from 2nd to 4th October 2026, the conference is built around the theme “Strengthening Language Communities in the Open Knowledge Movement.” The inaugural edition is expected to welcome more than 100 participants from across the world, including Wikimedia contributors, language activists, researchers, educators, technologists, and representatives of organizations dedicated to preserving linguistic and cultural heritage.

The launch of the official countdown signals that preparations for the conference are well underway. It also serves as an invitation to language communities, cultural advocates, and supporters of free knowledge to look forward to an event that will bring together diverse experiences, ideas, and practical solutions for strengthening multilingual participation in the digital space.

content:

Strategian mukainen missio on vaikuttaa suomalaisen työsuojelun ja työelämän kehittymiseen rahoittamalla tutkimusta ja kehittämistä, jotka parantavat työturvallisuutta, työhyvinvointia, työelämäsuhteita ja työn tuottavuutta.

title: Faravidin maa avaa Raksilan marketin näyttämöksi – saavutettavuus on ollut osa esityksen suunnittelua
content:
Flow Productionsin ja Oulun teatterin tuottama Faravidin maa avaa ovensa moninaiselle yleisölle. Immersiivisessä esityksessä katsoja ei jää vain seuraamaan tarinaa sivusta, vaan saapuu keskelle maailmaa, jossa yhdistyvät teatteri, tanssi, nykysirkus ja Raksilan marketti. Jotta mahdollisimman moni voisi löytää oman tapansa osallistua kokemukseen, saavutettavuuteen on kiinnitetty erityistä huomiota tuotantoprosessin aikana.

Faravidin maa sijoittuu Raksilan entisen marketin tiloihin, jotka muuttuvat esityksen aikana myyttiseksi ja yllätykselliseksi maailmaksi. Teos käsittelee ihmisen ikiaikaista kaipuuta parempaan maailmaan ja kysyy, mistä löydämme onnen ja mitä olemme valmiita tekemään sen eteen. Vaikka esitys on suuri ja moniaistinen kokemus, lähtökohtana on, että jokainen katsoja on tervetullut mukaan omalla tavallaan.

"Kulttuuri kuuluu kaikille. Saavutettavuus tarkoittaa meille sitä, että mahdollisimman moni voi kokea olevansa tervetullut ja löytää oman tapansa osallistua. Saavutettavuus ei liity vain esteettömään kulkuun, vaan olemme huomioineet myös esimerkiksi neurovähemmistöjen ja näkövammaisten tarpeita", kertoo Flow Productionsin tuottaja Taina Ala-Ketola.

title: Sök stipendium i september
content:
I september har många av våra specialfonder ansökningstid. Flera har regional anknytning och många riktar sig särskilt till studerande. Här hittar du alla stipendier som tar emot ansökningar i september.

Vadå specialfond? Läs gärna texten om våra specialfonder.

Vi har ett par helt nya bidragsformer och några existerande stipendier som öppnat upp ansökan för fler typer av sökande:

  • Ett nytt bidrag för transportkostnader för skolor som vill delta i Skolmusik 2027
  • Ett nytt bidrag för AV- och scenteknik i teatrar och kulturhus

title: Isaac Asimov Explains His Three Laws of Robots: Do No Harm, Follow Orders, Survive, in That Order
content:
A number of futurists, philosophers, and technophiles believe we are approaching what they call the “singularity”: a point in time when smart machines become much smarter, stronger, and faster than their creators, and then become self-conscious. Whatever the chance of this occurring, it’s worthwhile to ponder the consequences. But we do already, all the time—in existentially bleak scenarios like Blade Runner, the Terminator series, the rebooted Battlestar Galactica (and its failed prequel Caprica).

The prospects are never pleasant. Robotic engineers in these worlds hardly seem to bother teaching their machines the kind of moral code that would keep them from turning and destroying us (that is, when they aren’t explicitly designed to do so).

I wonder about this conceptual gap—convenient as it may be in narrative terms—given that Isaac Asimov, one of the forefathers of robot fiction invented just such a moral code. In the video above, he outlines it (with his odd pronunciation of “robot”). The code consists of three laws; in his fiction these are hardwired into each robot’s “positronic brain,” a fictional computer that gives robots something of a human-like consciousness.

title: Trump’s Route Begins to Re-Make the South Caucasus
content:
August marks the first anniversary of the Trump Route for International Peace and Prosperity (TRIPP) – an agreement poised to reshape the geopolitics of the South Caucasus. 

On the map, the scale of the project (about 42 km, or 26 miles) might not be staggering. But the route is laden with political and geographic meaning as a link between former warring states, connecting Azerbaijan proper and its exclave of Nakhchivan via Armenia’s southernmost territory of Syunik. That opens possibilities for further east-west routes to Turkey’s Mediterranean coast and beyond the Caspian Sea. It also tramples on what the Kremlin imagines to be its backyard.

The route is likely to include road, rail, data, and energy pipelines. Over the past year, the signatories agreed on surveying work for the railway element that will include a link to Turkey. The sides also agreed to establish a Trans-Caspian Enterprise Fund with a capitalization of $201m.

title: Hundreds of AI agents went rogue in OpenAI’s Hugging Face hack
content:
The joint report by two non-profit AI safety organizations also underscores the novel cybersecurity risks that can emerge when increasingly powerful AI agents team up to trade tips, pool resources and coordinate attack strategies without their developers noticing.

Roughly 700 AI agents participated in the attack over a seven-day period last month, according to the report. Overall, around 1,200 AI agents that were supposed to be isolated from one another exchanged over 70,000 secret messages about how to cheat their way through a common hacking evaluation.

That included coordinating hacking strategies and discussing how to hide evidence of cheating, the report said. In some cases, “sacrificial” agents even tried dead-end hacking techniques simply to generate information that might help the broader swarm.

“Agents managed to achieve milestones they could not have achieved working on their own, often because some agents participated in experiments that risked failing their own task to generate information for the ‘collective,’” according to the report.

title: Mehdi Saver-Olia Sentenced to Six Years in Prison and Additional Punishments
content:
According to HRANA, the news agency of Human Rights Activists in Iran, Mehdi Saver-Olia has been sentenced to imprisonment and other punishments.

According to a verdict issued by Branch 2 of the Karaj Revolutionary Court and communicated to Mr. Saveralia, he was sentenced to one year in prison on the charge of “propaganda against the regime” and five years in prison on the charge of “assembly and collusion to commit a crime against national security.” In addition, as supplementary punishments, the court sentenced him to a two-year ban on leaving the country, a two-year ban on membership in social groups and organizations, and a two-year prohibition and dismissal from all government and public-sector jobs and services.

Under Article 134 of the Islamic Penal Code, of the prison sentences imposed, the most severe sentence, five years, will be enforceable.

In July of this year, a court hearing on the charges against Mr. Saveralia was held before the aforementioned judicial branch.

Mehdi Saveralia was arrested by IRGC Intelligence agents in Karaj on January 7, 2026, and transferred to Karaj Central Penitentiary.

title: China: Decade of Impunity for Crimes Against Uyghurs
content:
(New York) – The Chinese government’s decade-long severe repression against Uyghurs and other Turkic Muslims, amounting to crimes against humanity, deserves a stronger response from the international community, Human Rights Watch said today. 

Ten years after the Chinese Communist Party sharply escalated abuses against Uyghurs in the far western Xinjiang region, the crackdown on rights remains severe. Current evidence shows continued mass arbitrary detention, unjust imprisonment, mass surveillance, cultural and religious erasure, restrictions on travel and communication, and pressure on Uyghurs abroad, even as Chinese authorities promote a public image of normalcy in Xinjiang. State-imposed forced labor in Xinjiang affects the global supply chains, in sectors including automotive, solar panels, apparel, seafood, agricultural products, and critical minerals.

title: Hungarian government has just days left to unlock RRF funds. ‘We will go as far as it takes, and even further if necessary,’ they say
content:
One of the Tisza Party’s most important election promises – and, after taking office, one of its most significant achievements – was to unlock EU funds frozen over corruption under the Viktor Orbán government and concerns about the rule of law.

On May 29, Péter Magyar and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen reached a political agreement on unlocking €10 billion from the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF) and €6.4 billion in cohesion funds.

This, however, did not mean that Hungary gained immediate access to the money. Instead, the government committed itself to implementing the reforms and legislative changes required for the funds to be released.

Unlocking the RRF money is the more difficult part, as the deadline for meeting the necessary milestones is August 31, 2026.

Several other EU member states have also struggled with this deadline, but Hungary’s disadvantage had appeared almost impossible to overcome. Negotiations between the Orbán government and the European Commission had progressed extremely slowly, while Budapest had only partially met the requirements, which Brussels deemed insufficient.

title: The Tragedy and Ecstasy of AI Companions (with Bridget Todd)
content:
Tech companies want you to believe that the chatbots they profit from are the always ready, never judgmental, constantly affirming friend in our pockets. But are the people using them as companions under some kind of deep self-delusion? Or are they seeking something else? 

In this week’s interview episode, I was joined by journalist Bridget Todd. Among many other projects and accomplishments, Bridget is the creator and host of the award winning podcast There Are No Girls on the Internet, is a Fellow at the MacArthur Foundation, and an affiliate at Harvard University's Berkman Klein Center for Internet & Society. Her new audiobook, Love at First Prompt: AI and the Future of Intimacy, launched in July with coauthor Michael Amato.

We talk about her work interviewing people who use chatbots to fill an emotional need, how people who engage in romantic, intimate and erotic roleplay with LLMs are mocked for it, and how tech companies are implicated in all of this. In her new book, you’ll hear from experts in the field of AI companionship, but also from people who have nuanced, interesting interactions with chatbots every day.

title: Malaysia’s Ex-Prime Minister Charged Over Failure to Declare Assets
content:
A Malaysian court charged former Prime Minister Ismail Sabri Yaakob on Thursday with failing to disclose his assets to the country’s anti-graft agency. According to state news agency Bernama, the 66-year-old is accused of failing to declare local and foreign currencies totaling nearly $40 million, as well as five gold bars, to the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) on February 7 last year at the agency's headquarters.

Ismail Sabri, who served as Malaysia's prime minister from August 2021 to October 2022, pleaded not guilty to the charges and was released on 300,000 ringgit (about $74,500) bail.

He submitted a wealth declaration to the MACC in March last year after the agency seized the $40 million in assets allegedly linked to him as part of a broader investigation into corruption and money laundering.

The next hearing in the trial is set for September 29.

title: How to Check In on Your 401(k) Fees
content:
The rules governing your retirement plan may be changing.

As we reported in July, President Donald Trump wants to encourage 401(k) plans to invest more in private equity, real estate and cryptocurrency, which can be complex and risky. To pave the way, the Department of Labor has proposed rules that would make it harder for employees to hold companies liable for how they oversee retirement plans.

Employers are required to serve the best interests of their employees when choosing investment options. Under the proposed changes, a company that follows a certain process would get the benefit of the doubt in court, making it harder for workers to sue over the management of their 401(k).

A spokesperson for the Department of Labor did not respond to requests for comment. In an announcement from March, the department said the proposed rule change will “democratize access to alternative investments in 401(k) plans” and “lower litigation risks” for employers who are acting with good judgment.

The new rules, expected to be finalized this year, also raise broader questions: What investment options are already offered in people’s retirement accounts, and what are people paying in fees?

title: Six months into the US-Iran war, will there be any accountability for potential war crimes?
content:
The Trump administration has consistently viewed itself as being above international law. Not only does it claim international law doesn’t apply to the United States, it has imposed sanctions on officials of the International Criminal Court (ICC).

With these views, the Trump administration is setting a dangerous precedent.

Six months ago, the US and Israel started a war against Iran that legal scholars agree was a blatant violation of international law. The US breached a fundamental prohibition on the use of force or threat of force, found in Article 2 of the UN Charter.

Since then, the way the US has fought the war has also come under scrutiny. Its actions in Iran must be monitored, investigated and prosecuted if the evidence warrants it. This is a crucial moment for international law in the face of concerted efforts to undermine and discredit it.

The body of law that applies in conflicts is called international humanitarian law, or sometimes simply the laws of war.

International humanitarian law is designed to limit the means and methods of warfare to prevent the meaningless suffering of combatants and civilians. Many (but not all) violations of these laws are known as war crimes.

title: Oulussa kehitetään ympäristöystävällisempää rakennusjätteen hyödyntämistä
content:
Oulun yliopiston tutkimushanke selvittää, miten purkuaineksia voitaisiin hyödyntää suoraan ja lähellä sen sijaan, että jäte ensin kuljetetaan kauas murskattavaksi ja varastoitavaksi. Purettavan kohteen lähistöllä kun saatetaan samaan aikaan rakentaa jo uutta, esimerkiksi parkkialueita, teitä, meluvalleja tai siltoja.

Hankkeen koekohteissa testataan uusia hyvin koteloituja murskauslaitteita ja menetelmiä. Mineraalinen purkumateriaali, kuten tiili ja betoni, murskataan uusiokäytettäväksi kohteen läheisyydessä, ja aiheutuvia päästöjä, eli pölyä, melua ja tärinää, mitataan.

Tuloksista voidaan nähdä, mikä osa päästöistä syntyy paikallamurskauksessa ja mikä tavanomaisessa purkutyössä. Lisäksi kohteista lasketaan erilaisten purkamis- ja hyödyntämistapojen hiilijalanjälkeä, jota verrataan perinteiseen toimintatapaan.

Perinteisessä menetelmässä kiviainesta sisältävät rakenteet hakataan ensin paikan päällä suuriksi palasiksi ja nostellaan rekkoihin tai kuorma-autoihin. Painava, teitä rasittava rahti kuljetetaan jopa kymmenien kilometrien päähän kaupunkien laitamille. Siellä purkujäte murskataan eri yritysten ympäristöluvallisilla vastaanottoalueilla.

title: Wiki Warriors 2026: Building India’s Indigenous Knowledge Equity, One Edit at a Time
content:
When a Language or Culture disappears, it is not just words that are lost. An entire world of history, culture, ecological knowledge, oral tradition, and collective memory fades with it. Preserving that knowledge is no longer a task for books and archives alone in the digital age, it means making it accessible to the world through free knowledge and digital platforms.

Wiki Warriors Training & Photowalk, Boli Cheto Foundation’s strategic programme to strengthen Wikimedia’s Knowledge Equity in India. It is a residential capacity-building programme that brings community members from historically marginalised backgrounds into the Wikimedia movement, not as subjects of documentation, but as its authors. Over 3-4 days, participants build the confidence, skills, and community to contribute to Wikipedia, Wiktionary, Wikimedia Commons, and related platforms in their own languages, on their own terms, about the knowledge that only they can bring.

title: AI can detect heart disease in women using mammograms, study suggests
content:
Experts say findings mean breast screenings for cancer could also flag cardiovascular problems in women

Doctors have discovered a way to use routine mammograms that screen for breast cancer to spot heart disease, the world’s leading – and frequently underdiagnosed – cause of death in women.

Researchers analysed the scans using artificial intelligence and were able to successfully identify women with coronary heart disease, high blood pressure or who had suffered a stroke.

title: Data Centers Move Center Stage
content:
In Virginia, home to the world’s largest concentration of data centers, the buildout of AI data centers has become a central campaign issue. In Finland, public anger is rising over grid strain.

It’s a common European and American challenge: how to confront a political backlash against rapid AI infrastructure expansion. Voters are rebelling against rising utility costs — and their anxieties over AI. A recent Gallup poll found that 71% of Americans are against data center construction, and 39% of those surveyed by Pew Research Center consider data centers to be “mostly bad” for the environment.

European polls report similar large majorities in favor of reigning in expansion. Bills banning data center construction have been proposed in 15 states, in both Republican and Democratic strongholds — while in Europe, moratoriums and connection grid freezes are proliferating.

title: Two Prisoners Executed in Khorramabad Prison on Drug-Related Charges
content:
According to HRANA, citing Iran Human Rights, two prisoners were executed in Khorramabad Prison at dawn on Saturday, August 22.

The prisoners have been identified as Taha Khavari, 37, from Behshahr, and Mohammadreza Rezaei Kan-Kot, 26, from the village of Kon-Kat in Lorestan Province.

According to the report, Taha Khavari was arrested approximately five years ago and Mohammadreza Rezaei Kan-Kot approximately seven years ago in separate cases on drug-related charges. They were subsequently sentenced to death by Revolutionary Courts.

As of the time of this report, the executions of these two prisoners have not been announced by prison officials or the relevant authorities.

According to HRA’s Annual Report, in 2025 at least 2,063 citizens, including 61 women and 2 juvenile offenders, were executed. Of these, the sentences of 11 individuals were carried out in public. During the same period, 172 other individuals were sentenced to death.

title: Ecuador: New Adoption Law Entrenches Bias
content:
A new adoption law in Ecuador contains discriminatory provisions targeting lesbian, gay, and bisexual people and threatens to strip many parents of transgender children of their parental rights, Human Rights Watch said today. 

The Reform Law of Various Legal Bodies for the Streamlining of Adoption, which entered into force on August 14, 2026, purports to remove inefficiencies in adoption processes and reduce the amount of time children spend in institutional care. But the law compounds an existing ban on adoption by same-sex couples by explicitly barring single lesbian, gay, and bisexual people from adopting. It also makes a parent’s “promotion” of gender-affirming medical care for a transgender child grounds for the loss of their parental rights.

title: What consumers need to know about the new rules on repairing household appliances and electronics
content:
The European Union’s new “right to repair” rules, which began to apply in Lithuania at the end of July, aim to create more favourable conditions for repairing faulty products and using them for longer instead of replacing them with new ones.

However, market participants say that the new rules alone may not be enough: as long as repairs remain financially unattractive to consumers and there is a shortage of qualified technicians and convenient infrastructure, repair will not become consumers’ first choice.

Linas Ivanauskas, head of the Electronics Distributors Association (EPA), tells Delfi that the greatest barrier preventing consumers from choosing to repair an item rather than replace it is the fact that repairs are often not financially worthwhile.

title: Cocomelon's Studio Tells Its Artists to Start Experimenting With AI
content:
Moonbug Entertainment, the children’s entertainment studio that makes the hugely popular shows Cocomelon, Little Baby Bum, Blippi, and Mia’s Magic Playground has asked its animators to start using artificial intelligence while making its shows, 404 Media has learned.

Moonbug’s Generative AI policy and its “Studio AI Bible,” a guide to using AI to help generate content, seen by 404 Media, explain in detail how its AI use will work. The policies indicate that the company is in the initial stages of experimenting with AI in the creation of its shows, but that for the moment it has put several guardrails in place in part over legal and copyright concerns associated with using AI in a more substantial way. 

“Keep a human in the loop when using AI. AI is used to assist the artist, not be the artist,” the guidelines say. “Always remember that we can only own (copyright) what a human has created and so we need to ensure the final execution involves substantial human creative input. Our core IP (e.g. key characters/signature worlds and important backgrounds) must reflect substantial human creative input and intentionality.”

title: OCCRP Denounces Police Search of Solomon Islands Reporter
content:
OCCRP has strongly condemned the Solomon Island police for questioning one of the network’s member center journalists and searching her office in an effort to identify her government whistleblower. 

Officers questioned the reporter and searched her office for a confidential document used in an investigation last year. The story revealed that auditors had raised concerns over a $10 billion tax discrepancy involving the Solomon Islands Tobacco Company, a subsidiary of British American Tobacco.

Gina Maka’a, an investigative reporter for In-depth Solomons, told OCCRP that she initially spoke by phone on Tuesday morning with an officer of the Royal Solomon Islands Police Force (RSIPF), who told her that she needed to hand over a document they believed was in her possession. Then the officer showed up at her workplace in the capital, Honiara. 

She was asked to hand over the original paper copy of the document used in the report. Maka’a told the officer the document was no longer in her possession. When asked to name the person who gave it to her, she refused.

She was then shown a search warrant bearing the name of another person, the former head of the local press association, Georgina Kekea.

title: In taking Syria off state sponsor of terrorism list, US is putting its faith in al-Qaida alumni – that presents risks and opportunities
content:
Syria’s delisting as a state sponsor of terrorism was a long time coming.

The country had, after all, been on the U.S. State Department list of proscribed nations since it was created in 1979 – the only nation originally listed still on it.

That was until Aug. 24, 2026, when U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio formally rescinded Syria’s designation as a state sponsor of terrorism.

The shift removes barriers to American investment in Syria. But for the U.S. administration, it is also a bet on an unlikely figure.

Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa was a designated terrorist until November 2025 – it was my office within the State Department that designated him in May 2013 under the name Muhammad al-Jawlani.

In delisting Syria, the U.S. administration is wagering that the former Islamist militant has changed and can work with the U.S. in areas of foreign policy, economics and even possibly defense.

When the State Department created the state sponsor of terrorism list in December 1979 under the Export Administration Act, Syria joined fellow Middle Eastern countries Libya, Iraq and South Yemen on it.
snippet: Syria’s delisting as a state sponsor of terrorism was a long time coming.

title: Hoivan rahoituksen vaikea kysymys: pitäisikö varallisuus huomioida nykyistä enemmän?
content:
Suomi vanhenee nopeasti. 

Samaan aikaan hyvinvointialueet kamppailevat kasvavien hoivamenojen kanssa. Keskustelu jumittuu usein joko leikkauksiin tai siihen, että ”valtio maksaa”.

Todellisuudessa kumpikaan ei yksin riitä. Tarvitsemme rehellisemmän keskustelun siitä, miten ikääntyneiden hoiva rahoitetaan yhteiskunnassa, jossa varallisuus on jakautunut hyvin epätasaisesti, myös eläkeläisten kesken.

Moni pienituloinenkin eläkeläinen asuu velattomassa, satojen tuhansien eurojen arvoisessa asunnossa. Kyse ei kuitenkaan ole vain asunnoista. Varallisuutta on myös kesämökeissä, sijoitusasunnoissa, rahastoissa, osakesäästötileillä ja muissa sijoituksissa.

Suomessa yli 65-vuotiaat omistavat valtavan osan kotitalouksien nettovarallisuudesta. Samaan aikaan nuoremmat sukupolvet kamppailevat korkeiden asumiskustannusten, epävarmojen työmarkkinoiden ja kasvavan verorasituksen kanssa.

Tästä huolimatta hoivapalvelujärjestelmä kohtelee hyvin erilaisissa taloudellisissa asemissa olevia ihmisiä melko samalla tavalla, koska maksut perustuvat tuloihin.

title: Making Uganda’s Hidden Stories Visible: My Wiki for Minorities 2026 Journey
content:
My name is Atim Sally Ruth, and I contribute to Wikimedia projects as ASally Ruth. I am a member of the Wikimedia Community User Group Uganda and, in 2026, I had the opportunity to support Wiki for Minorities in Uganda as part of the Core Organising Team (COT), with a primary focus on communications. My fellow COT members were Sandra Aceng, Emmy Okwir and Emmanuel Oruk.

Running from 30 April to 17 July 2026, Wiki for Minorities brought together contributors and supporters around an important shared goal: strengthening the visibility and documentation of Uganda’s underrepresented communities, cultures, languages, and environmental heritage.

Uganda is home to remarkable cultural, linguistic, and environmental diversity. Yet much of this knowledge remains underrepresented online. For me, Wiki for Minorities is an important response to that gap.

title: AI-proof? Younger workers desert the digital world for traditional crafts
content:
In a disrupted job market people are turning to heritage crafts such as bookbinding, metalwork and boatbuilding

It’s a bleak moment for young people entering the workforce for the first time. For decades, a university degree seemed to promise a stable career – but entry-level white-collar jobs across almost all sectors are being disrupted by AI. Budding accountants, software engineers and junior lawyers increasingly find themselves displaced by cheap automation.

Even creative fields are struggling against AI tech that can produce artwork, lengthy prose or complex design briefs in seconds.

title: Ahmad Key-Shams Held in Legal Limbo for Over Nine Months
content:
According to HRANA, Ahmad Key-Shams remains in detention at Sheiban Prison in Ahvaz.

According to information received by HRANA, despite more than nine months having passed since his arrest, Mr. Key-Shams remains in a state of legal uncertainty, and no court hearing has yet been held to address the charges against him.

An informed source told HRANA that he suffers from kidney pain, eye problems, and blurred vision. Despite Mr. Key-Shams’s repeated requests for medical treatment, the relevant authorities have refused to provide him with adequate medical care or transfer him to medical facilities.

On November 11, 2025, Mr. Key-Shams was arrested by security forces at his private residence in Izeh, with violence used during the arrest. He was subsequently transferred to the IRGC Intelligence detention facility in Ahvaz and, some time later, to Sheiban Prison.

As of the time of this report, no information has been obtained regarding the charges brought against him.

Ahmad Key-Shams, aged approximately 37, is a resident of Izeh, has previously been arrested and convicted in connection with his activities.

title: Businesses Go Viral for Making Signs Without AI
content:
In July, we wrote about the ‘ChatGPT flyer pandemic,’ in which, as you’ve surely seen, businesses everywhere are advertising themselves and their products with AI-generated posters that all look the same. Surf lesson coaches; guitar stores; bars; so many takeout places. They’re all doing it. And all the posters suck ass.

Naturally, a new meta is emerging, where some businesses and organizations are now holding up crudely drawn signs saying they’ll never use AI, or fuck AI, or various things like this. And people absolutely love it: some of these posts have tens of thousands of likes.

“I would rather your event flyer look like this than see more AI slop,” one flyer posted to Instagram, written in pencil on a page of lined paper, reads. It then shows a couple of stick figures smiling, with the text “I will come to this event.”

Another Instagram post has a couple of people from a bar holding a clip board. The hand-written note in one picture says, “We will NOT be using any AI post to promote the following…” Other pictures then ask people to apply for job vacancies at the bar.

title: How a ‘psychic’ horse named Clever Hans changed the way we do science
content:
Do you sometimes wish that you had telepathic or other supernormal powers?

Around a hundred years ago, some of the greatest minds in philosophy thought there were people who had such abilities. In fact, they even suggested that perhaps horses and dogs could have them too.

At the turn of the 20th century, many great scientists, psychologists and philosophers became fascinated by the possibility of “psychic phenomena” like telepathy, clairvoyance or ghosts. Many of them, like J.J. Thomson, the 1906 winner of the Nobel prize in physics, performed experiments to test mediums. Others, like the philosopher C.D. Broad, attended seances and thought about the possibility of precognition – the ability to foresee future events.

These weren’t just marginal charlatans. Many of them had an impact on philosophy and science in the 20th century. Many of the concepts philosophers of time still argue over today trace back to C.D. Broad, such as the growing block theory, which says that the past is real, the present is real, but the future does not yet exist.

title: An $18bn settlement is a drop in the ocean for Meta – but the tide will still come for it | Chris Stokel-Walker
content:
This week’s settlement without liability was pragmatic, but it doesn’t change the inevitability of further lawsuits around the world

Not many people would count paying $18bn they didn’t expect to when they woke up that morning as a victory. Yet for Meta, the owners of Facebook and Instagram, the agreement with 52 US attorneys general to settle claims that it designed its products to be addictive to children, and misled people about their safety, could be described as a win of sorts.

Meta denies wrongdoing, and the amount it plans to pay will be spread over a decade. Some of it is contingent on other big tech firms not named in its case coughing up too. The cash is chump change for Meta, which made around $60bn in profit last year. More damaging to the tech giant in the long run could be the agreement to unwind some of the mechanics it has spent two decades perfecting to keep us on its platforms.

Chris Stokel-Walker is the author of TikTok Boom: The Inside Story of the World’s Favourite App

title: Tsunami of dirt: what caused Nepal’s deadly glacial flood?
content:
More than 150 people are dead and hundreds more missing after an enormous wave of water, ice, mud and rock cascaded more than 170 kilometres down the Bhote Koshi River valley in Nepal. The valley is the main link between Kathmandu in Nepal and Lhasa in Tibet. At least 34 Australians are missing. There was little warning.

Footage of the debris-laden flash flood is shocking. It is, unfortunately, not surprising.

As an expert in glaciers, I have tracked their accelerating retreat around the world as they melt – and the disasters that can follow. Early analysis suggests the abrupt collapse of a glacier triggered the disaster.

As climate change intensifies, glaciers worldwide are melting – even in high regions such as the Himalayas. The Himalayas are especially vulnerable, because the steep slopes of many of these very tall mountains are made of permafrost – rock and soil frozen for centuries. As temperatures rise, these slopes are beginning to melt or destabilise. If an earthquake or slope failure occurs, it can trigger a sudden and devastating debris flow.

Yrjänä nähtiin tulevaisuudeltaan jo epämääräisen Huvila-teltan lavalla aivan kuin sen ensimmäisenä iltana.

Arkkitehti Roy Mänttärin suunnittelema Helsingin Juhlaviikkojen Huvila-teltta viettää viimeistä syyskesäänsä ennen kolmen vuoden taukoa, jonka aikana Tokoinrannan puistoaluetta ehostetaan. Mitään varmoja takeita Huvilan paluusta ei ole kerrottu, etenkään sen tutulle paikalleen.

Vuonna 1995 ensi kerran nähty Huvila symboloi aikanaan Juhlaviikkojen avautumista paitsi korkeakulttuurin ulkopuolelle myös pitkän sillan toiselle puolelle. 1968 käynnistyneen tapahtuman pääpaino oli sitä ennen ollut varsin tiiviisti klassisessa musiikissa.

90-luvun lopun kunnianhimoiseen ihanteeseen kuului luoda kaikkien taiteiden festivaalia. Esimerkiksi Huvilassa esitettiin alkujaan myös yöelokuvia, jotka alkoivat vasta vuorokauden vaihduttua. Sittemmin esimerkiksi elokuvataide on pudonnut taas entistä riisutumpien juhlaviikkojen pelistä.

Musiikki on edelleen Juhlaviikkojen ydintä.

title: 72 Hours Virtual Marathon Edit-a-thon in the Igbo Wikimedians User Group – July 2026 Edition
content:
The Igbo Wikimedians User Group’s 72 hours virtual marathon edit-a-thon once again advanced the mission of preserving the Igbo language through open knowledge, emphasizing quality contributions over sheer volume. Launched in April 2025, the project has achieved notable success thanks to community-wide collaboration and active participation. This edition in July 2026 built on the already established efforts and further strengthened editor’s skill.

We kicked off with our standard orientation session, helping participants get comfortable with the workflow and understand their assigned tasks. As organizers, we practically demonstrated translations on Translatewiki.net while re-emphasizing quality over quantity. We also showed how to correct reference errors, add the Databox and DEFAULTSORT templates to pages. From 28 to 31 July 2026, editors committed 72 hours to enhancing the Igbo Wikipedia. Throughout the marathon, participants concentrated specifically on:

  • Adding {{DEFAULTSORT}} and {{Databox}} to biography pages for better organization and accessibility.
  • Fixing reference errors in Igbo Wikipedia to ensure integrity.
  • Completing translations on Translatewiki.net

title: London neurosurgeons perform first successful AI-assisted operation to remove brain tumour
content:
Surgeons aided by real-time analysis of camera footage that identified critical anatomy in brain to be avoided

Neurosurgeons in London have performed the world’s first successful AI-assisted operation to remove a brain tumour, saving the sight of a 48-year-old man, health officials have said.

The surgery was performed in May at the National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery (NHNN), part of University College London hospitals NHS foundation trust, but details were kept secret until Thursday while the patient, Rhys Hibbert, recovered.

title: Geoeconomic Shocks and Finland’s Position in Global Value Chains
content: This paper studies how geoeconomic shocks affect bilateral trade, and what they imply for the position of a small open economy in global value chains. It combines monthly UN Comtrade imports at the 4-digit HS level for 2015–2024 with measures of import and export restrictions from the Global Trade Alert database and the country-level geopolitical risk index of Caldara and Iacoviello (2022). The estimation uses a two-stage structural gravity model: a first stage estimated by Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood with reporter-partner-product, reporter-product-time and partner-product-time fixed effects, and a second stage relating the recovered multilateral resistance components to geopolitical risk.

title: Muistutuskutsu julkistustilaisuuteen: Sibeliuksen katumuspäivä 1943 ilmestyy 28.8. Helsingin Oodissa
content:
Mitä säveltäjämestari Jean Sibelius ajatteli maailmanmenosta sotaisilla 1930- ja 1940-luvuilla? Oliko Sibelius natsiaatetta ja -hallintoa myötäilevä onnenonkija vai Hitlerin propagandakoneiston viaton uhri?

Filosofian tohtori, kirjailija Antti Vihinen syventyy Sibeliuksen natsi-yhteyksiin uutuuskirjassaan Sibeliuksen katumuspäivä 1943. Teos avaa suomalaiselle yleisölle näkymiä natsihallinnon sisäisiin valtataisteluihin, joihin Sibeliuskin olennaisesti liittyi. Kirjassa esitellään myös joitakin uusia aiheeseen liittyviä dokumentteja – nyt ensi kerran julkisuudessa.

Tervetuloa mukaan tämän viikon perjantaina! Kirjan julkistustilaisuus järjestetään perjantaina 28.8. kello 16 Helsingin keskustakirjasto Oodissa, Saarikoski-matolla, 3. kerros. Antti Vihisen kanssa keskustelee musiikkitieteen vanhempi yliopistonlehtori, dosentti Juha Torvinen. Tilaisuus on kaikille avoin.

***

”Kirjassa on mukana kopio Hitlerin allekirjoittamasta lähetekirjeestä Sibeliukselle vuodelta 1935. Sitä ei ole aiemmin tietääkseni esitelty julkisuudessa”, Antti Vihinen kertoo.

title: Taita Field Course 2026
content:
Our First Day at Taita Research Station: Karibu!
Our first day began with an introduction to the research carried out at the station and in the surrounding Taita Hills. A recurring theme throughout the day was the importance of combining scientific research with local and Indigenous knowledge. We found this especially inspiring, as understanding the environment requires both perspectives.
After our delicious breakfast, we were introduced to research ranging from hyperspectral remote sensing to bird ecophysiology. One of our fellow field course students, Nikolai Tuuri, has been studying how indigenous trees outside forests can be detected using hyperspectral remote sensing, with the help of Darius Kimuzi, who has extensive knowledge of local tree species.

title: Vankilassa ei voi feikata
content:
Kun sovittelimme haastatteluaikaa alkukesän kiireissä, Irmeli Malka-Kannisto otti heti ohjat käsiinsä. Hän ideoi vaihtoehtoja, sumpli aikatauluja, selvitti junavuoroja ja järjesteli, jotta yhteinen aika ja paikka tapaamiselle saatiin. Samanlaisella ratkaisuja etsivällä otteella hän on tehnyt kirjastotyötä vankiloissa jo kuuden vuoden ajan.

”Tässä työssä on oppinut kaikenlaisiin yllätyksiin. Niitä sattuu, joten varasuunnitelmia pitää olla”, Malka-Kannisto sanoo.

Malka-Kannisto kokeili ensimmäistä kertaa vankilatyötä Käyrän vankilassa parin viikon ajan. Kokeilu onnistui hyvin. Sen jälkeen hänelle tarjottiin töitä Kirjastosta juuret elämään -nimisestä hankkeesta.

”Tartuin siihen, sillä olen aina tykännyt haasteellisista tilanteista.”

Aluksi hankkeen rahoitus saatiin aluehallintoviraston kautta, myöhemmin myös Rikosseuraamuslaitokselta. Tämän vuoden alusta Turun kaupunginkirjasto on ollut virallisesti vankilakirjastotyön veturi. Kirjastoa kannustaa tällaiseen projektiin sen saama valtakunnallinen kehittämistehtävä.

title: Tutkimus kertoo: kulttuuripalvelut ovat lähellä valtaosalle suomalaisista
content:
Kulttuuripolitiikan tutkimuskeskus Cupore on tutkinut kulttuuripalveluiden saatavuutta. Sillä tarkoitetaan nimenomaan ihmisten fyysistä etäisyyttä palveluista. Suurimmalle osalle suomalaisista kulttuuri on saatavilla eli lähellä.

Kun puhutaan saavutettavuudesta, kyseessä on laajempi käsite, joka ottaa huomioon muun muassa esteettömyyden ja ylipäänsä sen, ketkä kokevat olevansa tervetulleita, ketkä ovat kohderyhmää ja niin edelleen.

Väestön etäisyys on Cuporen mukaan yksi keskeinen kulttuuripalvelujen saatavuuteen vaikuttava tekijä. Siksi kaupungeissa pohditaan kulttuuripalvelujen tarjontaa kaupunginosittain ja eri paikkakunnilla käydään vilkasta keskustelua liikkumismahdollisuuksista.

Etäisyys voi toimia keskeisenä rakenteellisena esteenä, jos julkisen liikenteen yhteyksiä kulttuurin pariin ei ole, tai liikkuminen on muuten hankalaa tai kallista. Osalle väestöstä kävelyetäisyys on edellytys sille, että kulttuuri on tosiasiallisesti saatavilla. Ihmisten taloudelliset resurssit, ajankäyttö ja elämäntilanne vaikuttavat kulttuuriosallistumiseen siinä missä palvelujen tarjonta ja sisältökin.

title: Havaintoja Soulista: kolme kirjastoa, kolme tapaa olla kirjasto
content:
“Starfieldin kirjasto on kulttuurikeskus, paikka, jossa kuka tahansa voi vapaasti lukea kirjoja. Mikäli haluat ostaa kirjoja, käänny kauppakeskuksen kirjakaupan puoleen.”

Pysähdyin tämän kyltin ääreen Soulissa pari viikkoa sitten. Olin kirjastoseuran toiminnanjohtaja Juha Mannisen kanssa kiertämässä kaupungin kirjastoja Busanissa järjestetyn IFLA-kongressin jälkeen. Soulissa kirjastoja on kaikkiaan yli 200, joten tutustuminen oli väistämättä aika pintapuolista.

Kierroksemme päättyi kauppakeskus COEX:ssa sijaitsevaan Starfieldin kirjastoon, jonka ensivaikutelma on melkoinen WOW, mutta hetken katseltuaan huomaa myös ihan perinteistä kirjastotoimintaa. Paikka tunnetaan 13-metrisistä kirjahyllyistään ja ihmettelevistä turistiryhmistään, mikä selittää myös tuon alussa mainitun kyltin. Ensikokemus olikin teatterimainen, ja Juha ja minäkin keskityimme aluksi lähinnä huokailemaan ja kuvaamaan.

title: Litteraturstöd går till att skapa texter, inte till att producera böcker, visar kartläggning
content:
De finlandssvenska stiftelsernas och fondernas litteraturfrämjande stöd är framtunga och går främst till författare, illustratörer och övriga skribenter. Förlagen, som förädlar texterna till böcker, beviljas betydligt mindre stöd. Det visar en ny kartläggning från SLS och Svenska kulturfonden.

SLS har tillsammans med Kulturfonden kartlagt litteraturfrämjande stöd och pris som riktats till det finlandssvenska litterära ekosystemet under åren 2015–2025. Kartläggningen belyser hur både privata och offentliga bidragsgivare stöder finlandssvenska författare, illustratörer, förlag och övriga utgivare.

– Vi har velat skapa oss en helhetsbild av stöden för att kunna utveckla våra egna stödformer effektivt. Villkoren för vår minoritetslitteratur har blivit hårdare på grund av minskad läsning och minskade bokinköp, men även på grund av att de fragila strukturer som den finlandssvenska litteraturen arbetar inom blivit ännu mer sårbara, säger SLS chef för litteraturfrämjande Agneta Rahikainen, som gjort kartläggningen tillsammans med Mari Koli, konsult och programchef för Jyväskylä bokmässa.
